summary: Rename generic fix locals to stage-accurate names in readiness checks

delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm Shotgun Surgery smell for the variable 'fix' in src/koru/autonomy/readiness/readiness.py (planfile ticket PLF-040, reported at line 890) by replacing the generic local with a stage-accurate name in two of the five functions that mutate it and removing the other three mutations as redundant selections: planfile_install_cmd (_planfile_availability_issue, the pip command that installs planfile - venv pip when present, plain pip fallback - used by all three planfile_unavailable issue variants) and bit_fix_command (_koru_runtime_identity_issue, the fix=-annotated command extracted from the koru path/version diagnostic bits). check_daemon_client_alignment keeps no local: its 'issues[0].fix_command if issues else None' is behavior-identical to passing primary_fix=None because _build_readiness_result already defaults a None primary_fix to _first_fix_command(issues), which returns the same value in every reachable case (a set issues[0].fix_command is by definition the first non-None fix command; a None one meant the old code also passed None and took the same default). check_workspace_socket_ownership keeps no local: its 'next((i.fix_command for i in issues if i.fix_command), None)' IS _first_fix_command(issues), exactly the builder default. check_lane_terminal_socket_alignment inlines its fallback into the pure selection 'primary_fix or _first_fix_command(issues)' (the helper is side-effect-free, so lazy or-evaluation is equivalent). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'fix' group drops from 5 scopes to 0 and the file mutation record count drops from 148 to 145 (the three removed records are the two deleted redundant selections and the inlined lane-alignment fallback). Each new name lands at exactly 1 scope. No behavior change: same issues, same primary_fix selection in every reachable case, same ReadinessResult shape, function signatures untouched. No other file touched. No duplication.toon.yaml exists in this repository, so the duplication-report checklist has nothing to consult for the touched path.
nonGoals: No behavior, policy, message or interface change

No rename of other same-file mutation groups (issues 10, meta 3, candidate 3 etc. each already below the >= 5 threshold or a separate unreported dedupe key); this lane only clears the reported 'fix' group of the cited dedupe key

No new shared helper; the two surviving bindings compute unrelated values (a pip install command vs a bit-extracted fix annotation) and forcing an abstraction would couple independent readiness stages
No rename of the issues parameters or _build_readiness_result/_first_fix_command themselves (read-only parameters and the shared builder are not counted as mutations by the detector)

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local naming plus pure selection inside one module. Every function that mutated the generic name 'fix' either names exactly the readiness stage it computes or no longer needs a local: the planfile availability probe names the pip command installing planfile (planfile_install_cmd), the runtime identity check names the fix command extracted from its diagnostic bits (bit_fix_command), the daemon-client alignment and workspace-socket-ownership checks drop their locals entirely because their selections are exactly the _build_readiness_result default (primary_fix=None defers to _first_fix_command(issues)), and the lane/terminal/socket alignment check keeps its explicit stage fix but inlines the fallback selection primary_fix or _first_fix_command(issues). The generic name 'fix' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports a 'fix' mutation group of exactly 5 scopes - _planfile_availability_issue, _koru_runtime_identity_issue, check_daemon_client_alignment, check_workspace_socket_ownership, check_lane_terminal_socket_alignment - matching the ticket's 'spans 5 functions'; after the change the 'fix' group is empty, the file mutation record count drops from 148 to 145, each renamed local lands at exactly 1 scope, and no other group newly reaches the threshold (next highest pre-existing: issues at 10, a separate unreported dedupe key; meta/candidate at 3).
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named fix again and the smell report returns.

validation.evidence: Deterministic ground truth with the installed code2llm extractor on the file AST. Baseline content reports a 'fix' mutation group of 5 scopes (_planfile_availability_issue, _koru_runtime_identity_issue, check_daemon_client_alignment, check_workspace_socket_ownership, check_lane_terminal_socket_alignment) - exactly matching the ticket's reported 'spans 5 functions'; renamed content reports a 'fix' group of 0 scopes; file mutation record count drops from 148 to 145 (the three removed records are the two deleted redundant selections and the inlined lane-alignment fallback); each renamed local lands at exactly 1 scope (planfile_install_cmd, bit_fix_command); no other variable group newly reaches the >= 5 threshold.

The readiness suite covering all five touched functions (planfile availability probing, runtime identity, daemon client alignment, workspace socket ownership, lane terminal socket alignment) passes unchanged - pure rename of function-internal locals plus redundant-selection removal whose values equal the _build_readiness_result default - and ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree with the changed files declared.
